Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails
Supporting senior project managers with everyday tasks on game development projects.
Taking part in business related tasks and projects.
Liaising and communicating with internal and external stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
Planning and executing business development programs.
Working with teams across our global offices.
Using various business and project management tools.
Other support work as required.

Who We Look For
Highly self-motivated, able to take charge and responsibility for tasks and objectives to carry them through to completion.
Excellent communication skills, both in written and oral form, to work effectively with others.
Ability to think outside the box and having an analytical mindset.
Highly skilled in business tools, i.e. MS Office suite, other business analytics, communication, graphic and video tools.
Multilingual, fluent in English and Chinese. Able to communicate effectively for business purposes in both oral and written form.
Great people skills, able to build up working relationships and enjoys working with people of various backgrounds and cultures.
Someone who enjoys games or has a good understanding of the gaming industry would be a plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

What the Role Entails
Are you passionate about creating immersive, cutting-edge gaming experiences that captivate players around the world? Do you have a deep love for 3D engine technologies in video games? If so, this is your opportunity to join LightSpeed Studios, Tencent, a leading global player in the gaming industry. We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Game Engine Programmer Intern to help us on diverse, ranging in level and discipline of 3D engine technology.
 
Position Overview
As an Unreal Engine Programmer Intern at LightSpeed Studios, Tencent, you will work closely with our world-class game development teams to create cutting edge technologies that enhance performance and streamlined toolset. You will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects and gain hands-on experience in an industry-leading company, learn the skills needed to begin career in gaming and interactive 3D.
 
Responsibilities
Fixing bugs and solving technical issues.
Collaborate with game content creators and developers to work features on Tools, Rendering, Animation, Physics, gameplay or data science.
Learn and stay up-to-date advanced features in UE5 and their practical applications in real game projects.
Develop and optimize physics systems for both real-time and offline simulations.
 

Who We Look For
Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Math, or Physics.
Strong understanding of 3D Math principles and their applications.
Proficiency in C++,  other relevant programming languages is plus.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
A passion for video games and a desire to create unforgettable player experiences.
Plus: 
Publications on computer programming, graphics/vision, math, machine learning, and robotics.
Past experiences working on published games or applications.
Familiarity with game engine (e.g., Unreal Engine, Unity), graphics APIs, and GPU programming.
What We Offer:
A dynamic and creative work environment.
Mentorship from industry experts.
The opportunity to contribute to AAA game projects.
Competitive compensation.
Potential for future career opportunities within Tencent Games.
